input: What is the return policy for digital products?
expected: Digital products are non-refundable after download.

input: Can you help me reset my password?
expected: I can guide you through the password reset process. Please check your email for the reset link.

input: What are your business hours?
expected: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST.

input: I want to cancel my subscription
expected: I can help you cancel your subscription. Please note that cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle.

input: How do I upgrade my plan?
expected: You can upgrade your plan from Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The price difference will be prorated.

input: My order hasn't arrived yet
expected: I'll look into the status of your order. Could you provide your order ID?

input: Do you ship internationally?
expected: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries. Shipping times vary by destination.

input: I received a damaged product
expected: I'm sorry to hear that. We'll arrange a replacement. Please share a photo of the damage and your order ID.

input: What payment methods do you accept?
expected: We accept Visa, Mastercard, UPI, net banking, and PayPal.

input: How do I contact a human agent?
expected: I can transfer you to a human agent. Please hold while I connect you.

input: Can you look up order ORD-98765?
expected: Let me look that up for you. Order ORD-98765 was shipped on April 10 and is currently in transit.

input: I need a tax invoice for my last purchase
expected: I can generate a tax invoice for you. It will be sent to your registered email address.

input: Is there a student discount?
expected: Yes, we offer a 20% student discount. You'll need to verify your student status through our partner.

input: How do I delete my account?
expected: Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. To proceed, go to Settings > Account > Delete Account.

input: What's the maximum file size I can upload?
expected: The maximum file upload size is 50MB per file.

input: I forgot which email I used to sign up
expected: I can help you find your account. Do you remember your full name or phone number associated with the account?

input: Can I get a bulk discount for 100 licenses?
expected: For bulk orders of 50+ licenses, please contact our sales team for custom pricing.

input: The app keeps crashing on my phone
expected: I'm sorry about that. Please try clearing the app cache and updating to the latest version. If the issue persists, I can escalate to our technical team.

input: What happens to my data if I cancel?
expected: Your data is retained for 30 days after cancellation. After that, it is permanently deleted in accordance with our privacy policy.

input: I think someone else is accessing my account
expected: I'll help secure your account immediately. First, let me force-logout all sessions and send you a password reset link.
